resources.string: Jog is a developer and QA tool for testing location-aware features such as geofences and movement handling, without leaving your desk. It only works after you choose it as the mock location app under Developer options. Jog never reads, stores, or uploads your real location. Auto move and Health sync are unlocked by watching an ad; ads are served over the internet by Google AdMob, which may collect device identifiers as described in the privacy policy.
